business_scope.primary_industry_name: Mobile Utility Software and Device Performance Optimization Apps

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Spain (national unitary commercial registry jurisdiction; Registro Mercantil Central in Madrid; Provincial Mercantile Registries operate delegated filings)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European legal tradition, harmonised with EU Directives; Hague Apostille Convention of 1961 in force)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo, as amended by Real Decreto-ley 7/2021 and Ley 6/2023; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo, Reglamento de la Ley 10/2010, as amended by Real Decreto 128/2023; Orden JUS/319/2018 creating the Registro de Titularidades Reales; Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 (Ley de Sociedades de Capital); Ley 18/2022, de 28 de septiembre, de creación y crecimiento de empresas (Crea y Crece).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of passport (passport-size identity page) of each shareholder and each director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the applicant's country of nationality; for Spanish residents, Comisaría General de Extranjería y Fronteras
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing state is a 1961 Hague Convention member; otherwise bilateral Consular Legalization through the Spanish Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of criminal record (certificado de antecedentes penales) for each proposed administrator or managing director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish Ministerio de Justicia (Registro Central de Penados) or equivalent competent authority of the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization when issued abroad; Spanish-origin certificates require no apostille for domestic notarial use

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of good standing (certificado de vigencia) of any corporate shareholder that will appear as a UBO chain intermediary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent commercial registry or corporate authority of the corporate shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, plus sworn Spanish translation (traducción jurada) when issued in a non-Spanish language

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO declaration form (Declaración de titular real) identifying all natural persons holding more than 25% of capital, voting rights, or ultimate control
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish Notary (Notaría) at execution of the incorporation deed and subsequent electronic filing to the Registro de Titularidades Reales
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial act internal to Spain; no apostille required for domestic registration, but the declaration must be notarially executed before the incorporation deed is signed

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: NIE (Número de Identidad de Extranjero) certificate for each non-resident shareholder or director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Spanish Consular Office in the applicant's country of residence or Comisaría General de Policía if the applicant is already present in Spain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization or apostille only where the underlying supporting document (e.g., foreign passport) must be authenticated; NIE card itself requires no apostille in Spain

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer due diligence (CDD) under Articles 3-5 of Ley 10/2010 with obligatory identification of the beneficial owner at the 25% threshold; mandatory screening of all shareholders, directors, and UBOs against the EU consolidated financial sanctions list (European External Action Service), the UN Security Council consolidated list, and the Spanish Comisión de Vigilancia de Actividades de Financiación del Terrorismo risk indicators; OFAC SDN list screening is adopted where the App Store payment rails (Apple IAP, Google Play Billing) settle through US-based channels or where USD-denominated remittances occur; PEP identification and enhanced due diligence (EDD) under Article 14 of Ley 10/2010 and FATF Recommendation 12, including Latin America national PEP index checks where LatAm expansion is contemplated; continuous transaction monitoring from account opening; risk-based review of the ISIC 6201 freemium mobile utility segment as Low_Risk_Standard.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Mercantil Central - Servicio de Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social (https://www.rmc.es/Denominaciones; online filing also available at https://www.registradores.org)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The proposed corporate name must be expressed in Spanish (castellano) or in any co-official language of the Spanish State (Catalan/Valencian, Basque, Galician). Foreign-language names are admissible only where the company operates under a foreign name as its principal identifying element or where the name is a registered EU trademark. Latin script is mandatory; accented characters and 'ñ' are permitted; the corporate suffix 'S.L.' or 'Sociedad Limitada' must accompany the denomination in all commercial documents. Any foreign-language credential supporting the name requires sworn translation into Spanish.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: España, Estado, Gobierno, Administración del Estado, Unión Europea, Comunidad Autónoma, Diputación, Ayuntamiento or equivalent identifying marks of the State or public administration (express ministerial authorization required)
Banco, Caja, Financiera, Crédito, Aseguradora, Reaseguradora or financial-industry terms reserved for licensed financial institutions
Oficial, Consejo, Colegio, Instituto, Universidad, Ministerio or institutional denominations that imply official recognition
Mundial, Internacional, Nacional, Ibérica or geographic-reach tokens that may mislead as to actual scope of activity
Names that are identical or phonetically/graphically confusingly similar to an existing Spanish or EU-registered business name
Expressions contrary to law, public order, or morality, and names that falsely describe the company activity
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The applicant files up to three proposed names in a single request; the Registro Mercantil Central grants priority to the first validly filed application. Upon rejection, the applicant may immediately re-file with three alternative denominations; the filing fee for the refused application is not refunded. A formal administrative appeal (recurso de alzada) is available under Ley 39/2015 to the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (Ministry of Justice) within one month of notification of a final denial, particularly where the denial rests on the prohibited-token doctrine and the applicant obtains the requisite prior ministerial authorization. Where the denial is based on similarity with an earlier reserved name, no waiver is available and a fresh reservation with a distinctive element is required. The negative name certificate cannot be extended beyond the statutory 180-day validity; a fresh application is required if the incorporation deed is not executed within the window.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Partially permissible. Article 9 of Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010 requires the registered office (domicilio social) to be situated in Spain at the place of effective management or principal establishment. Virtual or co-working office addresses are accepted by notaries and provincial mercantile registries provided the address is a verifiable physical location with letterbox, mail-forwarding, and legal notification-receiving capacity; however, the Agencia Tributaria (AEAT) may reclassify the tax domicile under the effective-management doctrine if no commercial substance (staff, equipment, or recurrent activity) is demonstrated. For the ISIC 6201 mobile utility app freemium model, a virtual office during pre-incorporation is tolerated, but a physical subscription or dedicated desk in the registered municipality is recommended before VAT and IAE activation.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low but non-negligible: approximately 5-10% probability of an AEAT unannounced on-site verification within the first 12 months for a low-risk, non-license-required software company with a clean UBO profile; the probability rises to approximately 20-25% where UBOs are non-resident, where the registered office is a mere virtual mailbox without local employment records, or where inconsistencies appear between the registered address and the actual place of development activity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance certificate (certificación negativa de denominación social) with up to three proposed names
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry tariff (approximately EUR 15-20 depending on online or in-person channel) per 2024 RMC fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial deed of incorporation (escritura de constitución) including notarial fees and protocol copies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary (Notaría) of the registered office jurisdiction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff scale (arancel notarial) for standard Sociedad Limitada formation; EUR 350-700 market range, EUR 550 typical in Madrid and Barcelona

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of articles of association (estatutos sociales) and pre-incorporation corporate legal advisory tailored to ISIC 6201 freemium model
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: 3-5 hours at EUR 150-250 per hour for boutique corporate practice; fixed-fee packages commonly EUR 400-900

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO and PEP/OFAC/UN sanctions screening reports (AML pre-incorporation diligence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: AML compliance provider or consulting firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark: EUR 100-250 flat fee for UBO matrix construction plus sanctions and PEP list screening package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIE (Número de Identidad de Extranjero) application for non-resident director/shareholder including apostille and consular legalization of supporting foreign documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish Consular Office and Ministry of Justice Legalization Section
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Consular tariff and Hague Apostille statutory fee of EUR 25-45 per document plus sworn translation and notarial ancillary costs

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial filing to the Registro de Titularidades Reales (UBO register) within ten days of incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registrar and registered compliance agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Registrar electronic filing statutory fee plus agent service fee; EUR 50-90 combined; mandatory under Real Decreto 304/2014 as amended

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Business opening communication (comunicación de apertura) to the municipal authority and IAE (Impuesto de Actividades Económicas) registration with AEAT
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Local city council and Agencia Tributaria (AEAT)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Municipal statutory fee for opening communication (EUR 0-120 depending on the municipality; IAE registration itself is exempt for companies with annual turnover below EUR 1 million)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account setup for receipt of Apple IAP and Google Play Billing remittances
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish credit institution (traditional bank or authorised neobank)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Standard onboarding is free or fee-waived for digital businesses; the bank requires the notarial deed, NIF certificate, and UBO declaration; any compliance fee is absorbed into the bank's general tariff

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); official e-portal: https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Before notarizing the incorporation deed, promoters file Modelo 036 with AEAT to obtain a provisional NIF (legal-entity NIF with B prefix for an SL). After the deed is registered with the Registro Mercantil, AEAT automatically issues the definitive NIF certificate without further application (normally within 1 month). Each foreign corporate shareholder must separately obtain a non-resident NIF: EU entities are assigned the NIF-UE prefix N and non-EU entities the prefix W, filed via Modelo 036/030 with the Central AEAT, accompanied by certified constitutional documents and a certificate of tax residence/domicile; the appointment of a Spanish tax representative is mandatory for non-EU shareholders. No physical presence or local bank account is a precondition. All registrations (Censo de Empresarios, VAT number, ROI for intra-EU operators) must be completed before the SL engages in VAT-taxable activity.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The SL is a Spanish tax resident (Ley 27/2014, art. 8.1) because it is incorporated under Spanish law and is subject to Corporate Income Tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) on worldwide income. No pass-through or fiscal transparency is available; the SL itself files Modelo 200 at the general 25% rate (15% reduced rate for qualifying newly created entities for the first 2 positive taxable-base periods under art. 29.1 LIS; 24% micro-enterprise rate for 2025 where net turnover is below EUR 1 million). Distributions to shareholders are separately subject to withholding. Foreign-source taxes are mitigated by the participation exemption (art. 21 LIS, 5% holding) and the ordinary foreign tax credit (art. 31 LIS), preserving territorial credit scope.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not operate a US-style check-the-box regime; corporate status is fixed by law. Available elections affecting tax identity: (a) group VAT consolidation election (régimen especial del grupo de entidades, art. 163quaterdecies LIVA) for entities with 50% or more common shareholding; (b) consolidated corporate income tax group election for Spanish entities held at least 75% (art. 67 LIS), adopting a group taxable base while each entity retains joint and several liability for the group tax debt; (c) SOCIMI/REIT listed real-estate vehicle election (Ley 11/2009) with 0%-15% rates and 80% distribution mandate; (d) patent box election (art. 23 LIS) limiting qualifying income deduction to 60% for eligible IP software and designs; (e) newly-created entity reduced rate election; (f) micro-enterprise and PYME accounting options; (g) anti-hybrid alignment elections under art. 15 quater LIS (ATAD) for structured finance arrangements. All elections are filed via Modelo 036 or within the annual Modelo 200 return.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (IVA) – VAT transposing Council Directive 2006/112/EC (Ley 37/1992, LIVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None. Spain applies no de minimis turnover threshold; any entrepreneur habitually supplying taxable goods or services in Spanish territory must register in the Censo de Empresarios via Modelo 036 and obtain a Spanish VAT number before starting operations. Non-established digital suppliers selling B2C services to Spanish consumers are relieved from direct registration where the app-store marketplace is the deemed taxable person (art. 84.4 LIVA) and collects Spanish VAT at 21%; direct B2C intra-EU digital supplies (outside a marketplace) require OSS registration via Modelo 036 and monthly/quarterly Modelo 369 declarations.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: B2B invoices between entrepreneurs must be issued in interoperable electronic format under the Crea y Crece Law (Ley 18/2022) and the Verifactu implementing Regulation (RD 1007/2023); acceptable formats are Facturae XML or the European standard UBL 2.1, with an integrity metadata chain (hash-linked event log) in the billing software. Any free tier or consumer purchase through Apple IAP or Google Play Billing is evidenced by the marketplace receipt and is not subject to the Facturae mandate. Real-time fiscal clearance as applied in Latin American jurisdictions is not implemented; Spain uses near-real-time SII reporting for obliged taxpayers (annual turnover above EUR 6 million and other listed categories), requiring transmission to AEAT of issued and received invoice records within 4 working days of the transaction. Export invoices are cross-checked electronically with customs SIGL clearance messages; no digital stamping or prior clearance of export invoices is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from Spain to non-EU destinations are zero-rated under art. 21 LIVA provided physical departure is proven within 3 months of supply by an accepted DUA/SAD export declaration. Intra-EU supplies of software licences to a VAT-registered customer are exempt under art. 25 LIVA when the customer's VIES number is validated and the supply is included in the recapitulative statement. For the mobile utility app model, App Store and Google Play sales to non-EU consumers are outside the scope of Spanish VAT (place of supply is the consumer's residence, art. 69.2 LIVA); related input VAT on platform commissions, cloud hosting, R&D tools and marketing is fully deductible and excess refunds are claimable monthly through Modelo 303. Exports of consulting or software-development services to non-resident business customers are released from Spanish VAT under art. 70.uno LIVA (reverse charge) with release substantiated by service contracts, technical delivery records and bank payment evidence.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Documento Unico Administrativo (DUA) / Single Administrative Document confirming customs export clearance with departure message (S10/EB1 status)
Bill of Lading (B/L) or Air Waybill (AWB) or CMR road consignment note proving physical removal from EU customs territory
Commercial invoice, packing list and Incoterms aligned to the export transaction
Inward remittance certificate – bank SWIFT credit confirmation matching foreign currency proceeds to the invoice and DUA value
Valid EU VAT number extracted from VIES and Intrastat statistical declaration records where intra-EU exempt supplies are claimed
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: AEAT's Export Audit Unit verifies DUA departure messages against transport documents, bank routing and payment evidence; missing or stale export proof within the statutory 3-month period triggers reversal of the zero rate, reassessment of 21% VAT plus default interest. Non-payment or late payment of the resulting assessment is a serious infraction subject to penalties between 50% and 150% of the tax base (Ley 58/2003 art. 191 LGT), reduced by 30% for voluntary conformity. Deliberately falsified export declarations or fictitious foreign consumers constitute criminal tax fraud under art. 305 of the Código Penal where the defrauded amount exceeds EUR 120,000, with imprisonment of 1 to 5 years. The AEAT clawback limitation period is 4 years from the end of the filing period, extending to 5 years (10 for aggravated fraud) in criminal proceedings; cumulative retrospective clawback for a series of fraudulent export refunds is not capped.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de España (Bank of Spain), operating within the European System of Central Banks; foreign-exchange statistical oversight is co-administered with the Ministry of Economic Affairs and Digital Transformation under the balance-of-payments (BOP) reporting framework.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Full convertibility for both current and capital accounts, anchored by Article 63 TFEU; no distinction is drawn between resident and non-resident transactions for EUR-denominated operations. Dividend and profit remittances from the Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (SL) are unrestricted, subject only to ordinary withholding tax (19% for non-resident shareholders, 0% under the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive where application conditions are met, or reduced treaty rates). Capital account operations require only ex-post statistical declaration to the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores; non-EU/EFTA direct investments in critical ICT sectors may trigger prior screening under Royal Decree-Law 8/2023, though a low-risk mobile utility app activities are normally outside the screening list.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion applies; Spain abolished all exchange control surrender requirements upon EMU accession, and the EUR is the SL's functional treasury currency. However, exporters must submit electronic balance-of-payments declarations via the Sistema de Declaración de Operaciones (SDO) to Banco de España for any individual payments or goods/services transaction equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000 in a calendar month, in accordance with Banco de España Circular 1/2007; underlying invoices must be retained for six years for foreign-exchange statistics and tax audit purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Deposit Account (Certificado de Depósito) + Operational Account (Cuenta Operativa)
Operational Account with digital onboarding and integrated tax-domiciliation (domiciliación bancaria)
Operational Account; dedicated merchant/settlement account for Apple IAP and Google Play Billing receipts
Operational Account via BStartup tech-company program
Operational Account; competitive tariffs for digital-service exporters

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium as a complementary rail only, not as a primary settlement account. EEA electronic money institutions (Wise Europe, Revolut Payments UAB/Revolut Bank, Airwallex, and similar) may lawfully issue euro IBAN accounts to the Spanish SL under the PSD2 and E-Money Directive passporting regime, and those accounts can receive Apple IAP and Google Play Billing payouts. However, EMIs are not substitutes for a Spanish credit institution for treasury purposes: Agencia Tributaria requires reporting of non-ES IBAN accounts, tax-domiciliation models (Modelo 200, 303, 111) function more reliably against an ES IBAN, and Spanish tier-1 banks may delay or restrict cross-entity flows from EMI accounts. Recommended structure: primary escrow plus operational accounts at a tier-1 Spanish bank, with an EMI used only for low-value disbursements, foreign-currency sub-accounts, and expedited outbound transfers.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of at least one identified legal representative is de facto mandatory for the initial authorization act: the corporate power of attorney must be granted before a Spanish notary or, for foreign execution, notarized abroad with a Hague Apostille and certified Spanish translation, before remote banking functions can be activated. The bank due-diligence interview may be completed by video-KYC only where the representative holds a valid Spanish digital certificate (certificado digital) or an NIE with electronic identification; otherwise, tier-1 banks require attendance at a branch. Law 10/2010 and Royal Decree 304/2014 allow equivalent electronic identity verification, but Spanish tier-1 institutions conservatively impose physical or notarial presence for non-resident directors and ultimate beneficial owners (UBO).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident director or UBO lacking a Spanish NIE, combined with an SL incorporated with EUR 1 share capital under the Ley Crea y Crece regime.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Passport notarized and apostilled; Spanish NIE or foreign-identification certificate; certified copy of the escritura de constitución and registration at the Registro Mercantil; notarized and legalized power of attorney; three months of personal and corporate bank statements; source-of-funds letter explaining the initial capital deposit.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Initial paid-in capital or software-development funding sourced from a related overseas holding company or from liquidation of digital-asset positions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board or shareholder resolution authorizing the capital contribution; executed shareholder loan agreement on arm's-length terms; source-of-wealth narrative with a complete bank transfer trail from the originating account; foreign-exchange conversion records; comfort letter from the remitting bank; tax clearance certificate of the overseas beneficial owner.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Registered office shown as a coworking or virtual-office address, with an 'app monetization' business narrative lacking verifiable merchant-of-record contracts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Registered-office lease or virtual-office service agreement naming the SL as tenant; executed Apple Developer Program Agreement and Google Play Developer Distribution Agreement evidencing the SL as contracting developer; three months of App Store Connect and Google Play payout reports; Apple and Google merchant identifiers; D-U-N-S or equivalent entity verification.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Politically exposed person (PEP) or high-risk jurisdiction flag on any shareholder crossing the 25% UBO ownership threshold.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Mandatory Spanish UBO registry filing (Registro de Titularidades Reales) under Law 10/2010; certified ownership-chain documentation to ultimate natural persons; passport and residence proof of the PEP; itemized source-of-funds documentation for all contributions into the Spanish entity; negative news and international sanctions-screening report from a reputable compliance database.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity injections: route via SWIFT MT103 with a Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference (UETR), using ISO purpose code EQUI, narrative 'Capital contribution – aportación de socios', referencing the notarial capital increase or initial share-capital deposit certificate and the post-closing foreign-investment registration on the Registro de Inversiones Exteriores. Intercompany shareholder loans: use ISO purpose codes LEND or INTE and support the transfer with a written loan agreement, certification of beneficial ownership, and, where the lender is non-resident, registration of the debt facility with Banco de España within 30 days. All inbound flows equal to or exceeding EUR 50,000 in a calendar month require an SDO balance-of-payments declaration; flows from non-EU investors may require prior Ministry of Trade screening only if the business falls within RDL 8/2023 critical sectors (not applicable to a low-risk mobile utility app). The receiving Spanish bank will clear funds same-day upon submission of the corporate resolution, UBO declaration, and proof of identity of the transferor; verification of the Ministerial foreign-direct-investment statistical filing is completed post-value.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Software services, cloud infrastructure, and AI tooling procurement: SEPA Credit Transfer (EEA providers) or SWIFT MT103 for non-EEA vendors, each disbursement backed by an invoice and service contract retained for statutory audit and BOP reporting. Cross-border hardware purchases above EUR 50,000 (e.g., server equipment) may use an irrevocable or standby documentary letter of credit confirmed by Santander, BBVA, or CaixaBank; open-account telegraphic transfer remains standard for lower-value recurring trade. Apple IAP and Google Play Billing settlements are inbound merchant-of-record remittances paid by Apple Distribution International Ltd (Ireland) and Google Commerce Ltd / Google Payment Ireland Ltd over SWIFT or SEPA; the SL must reconcile payout statements to the operational account on the 45-day settlement cycle and retain the payout reports for transfer-pricing and VAT audit defense. All outbound trade-related payments must satisfy Banco de España SDO reporting at the monthly EUR 50,000 threshold and be supported by intercompany or agency agreements where payments are made to related parties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable plain-vanilla FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) executed with Spanish tier-1 credit institutions under a bilateral ISDA Master Agreement or Banco de España-accepted master forwarding agreement; permitted only for hedges of documented underlying treasury exposure and prohibited for speculative positions.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in Latin American currencies (ARS, CLP, PEN, MXN, BRL) to hedge Apple and Google payer-currency waterfalls and local marketing costs in the target LATAM expansion corridor; permissible where no deliverable onshore market is accessible, subject to MiFID II appropriateness assessment and EMIR trade-reporting obligations.

Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) for long-term intercompany debt from a non-resident parent, executed under a bilateral ISDA/CSA with margin integration at BBVA or Santander treasury desks; restricted to hedges of principal and interest of Banco de España-registered external borrowings.

FX vanilla options and zero-premium collar structures permitted only for treasury risk management with a maximum notional tenor of twelve months and a notional cap set by the corporate hedging policy; a non-financial counterparty under EMIR is not permitted these instruments for speculative position-taking.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Accounts Deposit (Depósito de Cuentas Anuales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Mercantile Registry (Registro Mercantil) with publication in the Official Gazette (BORME)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the financial year-end; for a 31 December year-end, on or before 31 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines of EUR 1,200 to EUR 6,000; registry closure (cierre registral) after repeated non-filing; if annual accounts remain unfiled for a prolonged period, the registry may close the corporate file and initiate dissolution/strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days after the six-month period following the tax year-end; for a calendar year-end, from 1 July to 25 July of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharges of 5% to 20% of the tax due; late-payment interest; penalties up to 150% of the understated tax; administrative asset seizure during the enforceable period and, in chronic cases, corporate deregistration/strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year taxpayers, on or before 30 January of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalties of EUR 200 to EUR 20,000 depending on turnover; late-payment interest; sustained non-filing can trigger tax ID suspension and eventual forced closure/strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO Confirmation (Declaración de Titularidad Real)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed concurrently with the annual accounts; any change in ultimate beneficial ownership must be filed within one month of the change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines under AML Law 10/2010 of up to EUR 60,000; continued non-compliance causes registry closure, blocking corporate filings and exposing the SL to dissolution/strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An SL must appoint an external auditor and file audited accounts if it exceeds, for two consecutive years, at least two of the following: total assets above EUR 4,000,000; annual net turnover above EUR 8,000,000; or average workforce above 50 employees. Audit may also be required by the shareholders' meeting, articles of association, or judicial order.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP under the Plan General de Contabilidad (Real Decreto 1514/2007); EU-IFRS for groups and listed entities; simplified small-entity framework under Real Decreto 1515/2007.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholding transfers must be recorded in the statutory share ledger, and UBO details must be updated in the annual accounts confirmation filed with the Mercantile Registry; any ownership change during the year must also be communicated within one month, independent of the annual filing cycle.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – USD 1,500 per year, dependent on registered office location and agent service scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 – USD 6,500 per engagement for a small-to-mid-size app-focused SL

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced-dimension enterprises (net turnover below EUR 1 million): 15% on the first EUR 30,000 of taxable base and 20% on the following EUR 20,000; qualifying startups under Law 28/2022 benefit from a 15% rate for the first taxable period and the following two periods; available credits include 25% R&D expense credit, 50% incremental R&D credit, 42% technology innovation credit, and patent-box partial exemption.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Modelo 200 (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) filed exclusively electronically via the Sede Electrónica of the Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); interim payments filed on Modelo 202 (Modelo 222 for groups) through the same portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing plus quarterly installment payments due in April (April 20 / May 15 depending on method), October (October 20 / November 15) and December (December 20 / January 15 for companies with turnover above EUR 10 million).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing must be submitted within 25 calendar days following the six-month period after the fiscal year-end (Article 124 LIS); for a calendar-year entity the deadline is 25 July of the following year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resultado contable del ejercicio: accounting profit or loss before corporate income tax after depreciation, provisions and app-store revenue recognition.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Mandatory for the resident Spanish SL; no non-resident branch filing applies because the entity is a Spanish fiscal resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Resultado contable ajustado: permanent differences for non-deductible expenses, including excess director remuneration and non-deductible payments to non-resident related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply adjustments under Articles 15 and 18 LIS; payments to non-resident shareholders on App Store proceeds must be reclassified if lacking economic substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compensación de bases imponibles negativas: tax-loss carryforward offset against current-period taxable base, capped at 70% of the pre-offset taxable base for profit-making periods.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only available to the resident legal entity; losses of foreign shareholders or foreign permanent establishments are not integrated here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Base imponible (taxable base) after loss compensation and all positive and negative adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be reconciled to the statutory accounts; non-resident shareholders are taxed under IRNR, not through this box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cuota íntegra: statutory tax computed by applying the 25% rate (or reduced scale) to the taxable base.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Rate applicable is the resident company rate; non-resident shareholders separately suffer withholding on distributions, not this computation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cuota íntegra ajustada after deductions for double taxation (international and domestic) and exemptions under the participation regime for EU/Norway/Iceland holdings.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Documentation must evidence qualifying shareholding percentages and minimum holding periods for foreign tax credits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cuota diferencial: final tax liability after withholdings suffered (Casilla 00400) and installment payments already made; payment by direct debit via bank account COD.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Refunds to foreign shareholders of excess 19% dividend withholding are claimed on Modelo 210, not Modelo 200.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing without prior AEAT notice: surcharge of 1% of outstanding tax per month up to 15%, plus late-payment interest; failure to file where tax is due: 5%-20% penalty on the tax assessed (minimum EUR 200); incomplete Modelo 200 data blocks: EUR 150 per block capped at EUR 6,000; omission or miscalculation of Modelo 202 installment payments: 50% of the unpaid installment plus default interest.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 19% statutory withholding on dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders under Article 25.1.f LIRNR; reduced to 0% for EU/EEA corporate shareholders meeting the Parent-Subsidiary Directive conditions (minimum 5% holding held for at least 12 months) and to applicable treaty rates (typically 0%-10%) under Spain’s tax treaties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To apply treaty relief the non-resident shareholder must: (1) obtain an official Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) in its residence state confirming tax residence; (2) provide the TRC to the Spanish paying entity before the distribution or, if the 19% has already been withheld, file a refund claim on Modelo 210 within the 4-year statute of limitations attaching the TRC, dividend voucher (Modelo 215), and evidence of beneficial ownership; (3) for withholding-rate treaties, certify absence of a Spanish permanent establishment or allocate income to a PE if one exists; the AEAT reviews beneficial-ownership substance so letterbox intermediates will be denied relief.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid to non-residents: statutory 24% under IRNR; EU Interest/Royalties Directive grants 0% when the beneficial owner is an EU/EEA associate company; typical treaty rates 10% (e.g., US-Spain, UK-Spain). Interest paid to non-residents: statutory 19%; treaty rates typically 10%-12%, with EU Parent-Subsidiary/I-R Directive 0% available to qualifying EU affiliates; both categories require Modelo 210 annual declaration and TRC-backed certification at source.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 45 million annual group/net turnover triggers mandatory full Master File and Local File; entities below this threshold must nevertheless maintain Local File documentation when related-party transactions exceed EUR 250,000 per counterparty per year; no threshold applies for transactions with related parties in blacklisted or zero-tax jurisdictions. Penalties for missing or inaccurate documentation: EUR 50,000 per omitted document and EUR 1,000 per inaccurate data item (Article 18.13 LIS).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Spain applies Economic Substance-type requirements through Article 15e LIS (general anti-abuse), Article 100 LIS (CFC rules), EU ATAD-implementing norms and Law 11/2021 on the prevention of tax fraud, which establishes rebuttable presumptions for shell or 'empty' companies (more than 75% passive income, no own premises, no local staff). A Spanish SL developing and distributing a mobile utility app must demonstrate real headcount, office premises, strategic management and R&D activity in Spain; otherwise treaty benefits, parent-subsidiary exemptions and the patent box are denied and the arrangement is recharacterized as an artificial scheme. The nexus approach under Article 23 LIS also limits IP relief to income from qualifying R&D physically developed in Spain.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / False Invoicing (Art. 305 Criminal Code)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing or obtaining facturas falsas to inflate deductible expenses; omitting App Store and Google Play revenue; under-reporting Apple/Google commission refunds; routing in-app purchase revenue through nominee accounts in a different territory to hide taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative: penalty of 50%-150% of the defrauded tax (150% for fraudulent concealment or use of shell structures) plus late-payment interest of 5%-6.25%; Criminal: imprisonment of 1 to 4 years (2 to 6 years when the amount defrauded exceeds EUR 600,000) plus a fine of up to double the defrauded amount and loss of subsidies or tax benefits for up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt and penalties under Article 42.1.a LGT where they knowingly participated in the omission or ordered the concealment; criminal directors face imprisonment, disqualification from managing Spanish companies and travel bans; the corporate veil is pierced for accomplice shareholders and de facto managers.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Artificial Substance Arrangement (Law 11/2021, Art. 15e LIS, ATAD GAAR)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Spanish SL as a letterbox that merely licenses app IP to a foreign affiliate at inflated prices, with no employees, no physical premises, no real commercial risk and all strategic decisions taken from a non-resident holding company; claiming treaty or EU directive benefits without substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative requalification: disregarded transaction, deemed income allocation to the Spanish entity, denial of treaty relief, upward transfer-pricing correction with a penalty of 50%-150% of the adjustment; Law 11/2021 applies a rebuttable presumption of tax residence in Spain and triggers the CFC regime on the foreign affiliate; a closing sanction (suspension of business activity for up to 3 months) may be imposed for repeated obstruction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who formalized the artificial arrangement are civilly liable for the unpaid corporate tax and sanctions (Article 42.1.b LGT when they intentionally created the insolvency or concealed assets); criminal liability for fiscal fraud where the artificial structure causes a tax loss exceeding EUR 120,000, carrying imprisonment and extradition-risk travel restrictions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Non-Compliance (Art. 18 LIS and RD 634/2015)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging below-arm's-length royalty rates to a foreign related app-distribution company without a benchmarking study; failing to prepare the Local File/Master File within the statutory time limits; not disclosing related-party microtransactions; submitting documentation with false comparable data.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Transfer-pricing adjustment with recapture of the under-reported taxable base plus penalty of 50%-150% of the resulting tax loss (aggravated penalty for non-compliance); independent documentation infringement: EUR 50,000 per missing or materially defective document and EUR 1,000 per incorrect datum; late-payment interest runs from the original filing due date to the final adjustment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who signed the Modelo 200 knowing the TP documentation was deficient are co-obligated to pay the penalty under Article 42.1.a LGT; a 25% subsidiary liability can attach where the director failed to prevent the infraction despite the availability of adequate internal control systems; deliberate mispricing to shift profit to a low-tax jurisdiction constitutes criminal tax evasion subject to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / Unreported Foreign Assets (Law 10/2010, Form 720, Art. 301 Criminal Code)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Holding developer royalties, crypto-proceeds or App Store settlement balances in unreported offshore bank accounts or foreign wallets without filing Form 720; executing transactions whose structure suggests layering between the Spanish SL and a shell intermediary; failing to establish customer due diligence on in-app payment volumes.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Form 720 omission or inaccuracy: flat penalty of 150% of the unreported asset value with a minimum of EUR 5,000 per item and a 10-year limitation period; AML administrative fines: up to EUR 150,000 for very serious infringements and EUR 600,000 for repeat serious infringements; criminal money laundering: imprisonment of 1 to 6 years and confiscation of proceeds; the SEPBLAC imposes corrective plans and can suspend the entity from commercial operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: AML violations attach directly to directors and compliance officers as individuals; fines may be imposed personally on the director who caused the failure, separate from corporate penalties; directors face asset freezing, travel bans and disqualification, and criminal conviction under Article 301 for facilitating money laundering through the corporate vehicle triggers direct imprisonment without the possibility of corporate veil protection.
